text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
...Phew.
I lost, didn't I... That's too bad...
choice_data_list: Sorry... I couldn't lead you to victory.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
I don't think taking on this race was in vain at all...
It was unfortunate, but there's no reason to be sad.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Because I still have the next race ahead of me...! Besides, I don't have the time to sit around lamenting.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Losing is truly frustrating.
And yet, being able to run and compete against someone
is such a wonderful, enjoyable thing...!
choice_data_list: I see, that sounds just like you.
I see, that's just like you.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Besides, Trainer, losing just means I've still got plenty of room to grow! ♪
choice_data_list: Then I'll have to train you hard!
Then I'll have to whip you into shape!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Besides, Trainer, losing just means I've still got plenty of room to grow! ♪
choice_data_list: Then I'll have to train you hard!
Then I'll have to whip you into shape!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Fufufu...! I can still become even stronger... Look forward to it.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Let's retrain and win next time♪
I'll give you some wonderful memories too!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
My, how harsh! But...
does that mean you've got your energy back?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Alright then, I'd better get fired up too,
and be ready for whatever 'strict training' you throw at me♪

Beneath Fine Motion's gentle smile,
a burning fighting spirit seemed to lie in wait...!
